title: ccperf's benchmark, the experiments this emulator can express, every controller
description: The 51 of the 121 experiments per controller in ccperf's benchmark (gitlab.com/ccperf/ccperf at 18d1620, with the semantics of its ns-3 backend at 7c1709f) that this emulator can express, plus synchronous fairness of 2 and 10 flows, which ccperf builds but never adds. They are single flows on ccperf's five static paths, synchronous and start-time fairness, loss resilience, deep and shallow buffers, rate steps, pulses and random walks, ccperf's three Poisson rate traces (copied in experiments/traces/ccperf) on its three dynamic paths, and fairness against Reno, Cubic and Vegas. Each runs 5 times with fresh seeds, start times and walks (experiments/ccperf.py, which names the divergences and the experiments left out). Every kernel controller, Sage's released policy (exp-sage-model-24), and the fixed rule (u = 0.125) and share rule (k = 1) on net1 v4. Scored by experiments/ccperf_report.py from each episode's flow_seconds table: utilization, queueing delay, Jain's index of the flows under test, and their share against a competitor over their fair share. The links are not the train, validation or test links, and nothing is chosen on them.
prepare: G="$IN/grid/$(cat "$IN/grid/chosen.txt")/net1.pt"; SAGE="$IN/sage/sage/sage.onnx"; echo "fc0d6f1da45e4948ee3d96784642793954ed5e52adc1eddd0c9883d5d8fe2f9e  $SAGE" | sha256sum -c; uv run python experiments/rule_export.py "$OUT/v4" "$G" --u 0.125; uv run python experiments/share_rule_export.py "$OUT/share" "$G" --u0 0.125 --k 1; uv run python experiments/ccperf.py "$OUT" --seed 11 --repeats 5 --stock all --policy "sage=$SAGE" --policy "rule-v4=$OUT/v4/rule-u0.125.onnx" --policy "share-k1=$OUT/share/share-u0.125-k1.onnx"
run: for c in "$OUT"/p-*; do uv run expliccit campaign run "$c" --shard "$SHARD/$SHARDS" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS" --tables flow_seconds; done
